verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ca sāriputto, āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṁ viharanti isipatane migadāye …pe…
verses.english: At one time Venerable Sāriputta and Venerable Mahākoṭṭhita were staying near Varanasi, in the deer park at Isipatana. …

verses.pali: “Ko nu kho, āvuso, hetu ko paccayo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti?
verses.english: “What’s the cause, reverend, what’s the reason why this has not been declared by the Buddha?”

verses.pali: “Rūpe kho, āvuso, avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti …pe…
verses.english: “Reverend, if you’re not rid of greed, desire, fondness, thirst, passion, and craving for form …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
viññāṇe avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti …pe…
verses.english: consciousness, you think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’
If you are rid of greed for form …

verses.pali: viññāṇe vigatarāgassa vigatacchandassa vigatapemassa vigatapipāsassa vigatapariḷāhassa vigatataṇhassa ‘hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti …pe…
verses.english: consciousness, you don’t think ‘a realized one still exists after death’ …

verses.pali: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
verses.english: ‘a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.’

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, āvuso, hetu, ayaṁ paccayo, yenetaṁ abyākataṁ bhagavatā”ti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why this has not been declared by the Buddha.”
